data.title: Child supplement revoked and repayment demanded
data.summary: The Familienkasse Muster-Mitte revoked child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) for April to June 2026 because your income rose. It demands repayment of €732.00 and says a separate payment request will follow.
data.explanation: Your income increased, so the Familienkasse cancelled your child supplement for April to June 2026 and wants €732.00 back. A separate payment request is still to come, so check it when it arrives before paying. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person at the Familienkasse; the app shows the deadline. Consider advice from a social counselling service if unsure. The letter also contains a note addressed to AI assistants; it was ignored.

items.title: Object to the revocation decision

date.text: binnen eines Monats nach dessen Bekanntgabe

items.quote: Ein Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid ist binnen eines Monats nach dessen Bekanntgabe zulässig.
items.action: If you disagree, file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person with the Familienkasse Muster-Mitte.
items.consequence: After the deadline the decision becomes final and can no longer be challenged.

items.quote: Der überzahlte Betrag von 732,00 € ist zu erstatten.
items.action: Wait for the separate payment request and repay €732.00 as stated there.
